results.remarks:
Welcome to this spacious and beautifully laid-out 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence in the heart of Bixby Knolls—one of Long Beach’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Offering an exceptional combination of size, functionality, and location, this home stands out with a highly desirable and rarely available private 2-car garage, a true rarity for condo living in this area .
Inside, you’ll find an expansive floor plan with generously sized rooms throughout, creating a comfortable and open living environment. Hard surface flooring flows through the main living areas, complemented by a tile kitchen featuring abundant cabinetry, a breakfast bar, and both a formal dining area and separate breakfast nook—ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The oversized living room opens to a large private balcony, perfect for enjoying fresh air, morning coffee, or evening relaxation.
Both bedrooms are well-proportioned, with the spacious primary suite offering its own private bathroom and ample closet space. The thoughtful layout provides privacy between living and sleeping areas while maintaining a natural flow throughout the home.
Located in the vibrant Bixby Knolls district, this home offers outstanding walkability to the popular Atlantic Avenue corridor, known for its boutique shopping, coffee houses, restaurants, and community events. Enjoy close proximity to parks, local schools, and everyday conveniences, along with easy access to major freeways for a seamless commute. The neighborhood’s tree-lined streets, strong community feel, and ongoing revitalization make it one of Long Beach’s most desirable places to live.
Whether you're looking for space, convenience, or lifestyle, this home delivers a rare opportunity to own a well-sized condo with premium features in an unbeatable location.

results.remarks:
The best part about living here isn't just the home. It's everything that happens around it.
Welcome to Above the Palms, 100 Loma Avenue #404. A beautifully remodeled top-floor residence in the coveted Bluff Park neighborhood of Long Beach one block to the ocean, where treetop views, ocean breezes, and natural light create an everyday sense of calm. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,124 square feet of thoughtfully designed living that feels equal parts modern retreat and coastal escape.
The heart of the home is the open-concept living space, where the designer kitchen flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas, creating a space that's equally suited for quiet mornings or gathering with friends. Crisp white shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom tile accents, recessed lighting, and a sleek fireplace give the home a clean, timeless feel.
The spacious primary suite feels like a boutique hotel, complete with a spa-inspired walk-in shower, dual vanity, large walk-in closet, and convenient in-unit laundry. A generous second bedroom includes lots of natural light and beautifully updated guest bath offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or whatever comes next.
Every window frames mature palms and open skies, creating a rare sense of privacy this close to the coast with glimpses toward the Pacific, while Belmont Shore, Bluff Park, Shoreline Village, Downtown Long Beach, waterfront dining, coffee shops, and miles of sandy coastline are all just moments away.
Whether you're starting the morning with a walk along the beach, grabbing coffee around the corner, working from home surrounded by natural light, or unwinding with sunset skies and cool coastal air, life simply feels different when you're living Above the Palms.

results.remarks:
Imagine waking up to soft mornings, light pouring through your windows, the scent of salt air drifting in, and nothing on your agenda but sunshine. This is life at Marina Pacifica.

Beautifully remodeled from top to bottom, this one bedroom, one bathroom residence is where sophisticated coastal living meets modern luxury and every detail has been thoughtfully curated just for you. A chef-inspired kitchen invites you to slow down and savor. Stylish flooring, modern lighting, and a beautifully updated bathroom bring elevated ease to everyday living. And those expansive windows? They fill every room with the kind of natural light that makes a house feel like home.

Step outside, and the magic continues. Along the shimmering waters of Los Alamitos Bay, you’re minutes from Belmont Shore, Naples Island, Belmont Park, and Seal Beach. Paddle board at sunrise, wander the farmers market on a lazy Sunday, or drift through the Naples canals by gondola as the sun sets. Craving a night out? 2nd & PCH is just around the corner with upscale dining, boutique shopping, and everything in between.

Come home to resort-style living every single day. Six pools and spas, a fitness center, a clubhouse, tranquil waterways, and 24-hour guard-gated security, all connected by picturesque bridges that make this community feel like its own private world.

This isn’t just a place to live. It’s a place to fall in love with.

Welcome home to Marina Pacifica.

results.remarks: Own a piece of history in this extraordinary extra large studio loft located in the legendary Villa Riviera. As a celebrated landmark on the National Register of Historic Places, this waterfront icon rarely offers such a fabulous unit to the market. Inside, you are greeted by soaring coved ceilings, bespoke plaster walls, and gorgeous hardwood floors that span the expansive living space. A stunning triple bay window framed by beautifully restored mahogany moldings perfectly captures breathtaking views of the downtown city skyline. The interior is brilliantly optimized with a contemporary Clayton Jacob Murphy bed and rich solid mahogany built in cabinetry, plus a unique upper deck bed for additional sleeping quarters. The stylish kitchen showcases striking sea foam granite countertops, eighteen inch granite floor tiles, and a charming custom retro dining nook. Step into the bathroom to find freshly installed grey subway tiles and classic fixtures that honor the building's vintage roots. Storage is abundant, featuring a cedar lined walk in closet and multiple upgraded compartments throughout. Living here grants you access to luxury amenities including a doorman, an ocean view ballroom equipped with a catering kitchen, a sprawling sun deck with communal barbecues, and a cozy cabana accented by a fire feature. Residents also enjoy a tranquil private garden with a bubbling fountain, inviting common outdoor patios, convenient bike storage, and a dedicated guest suite for visiting friends. Your homeowner association dues cover every utility imaginable, including gas, electricity, hot water, cable television, and high speed internet. Secured parking is available to lease directly through the building management, with alternative parking solutions offered nearby.

results.remarks: Discover the ultimate expression of coastal luxury and vibrant downtown living, where modern design meets the heartbeat of the city. This ultra modern space is far more than a home, it is a lifestyle destination. With an impressive 1,050 sq ft of bold open concept living, this is the largest one bedroom layout in the building and a rare opportunity to live expansively in one of Long Beach’s most desirable urban communities. Vaulted ceilings enhance the airy atmosphere while natural light illuminates every corner. The massive living and dining area with a nook offers flexibility to design the perfect entertainment space, home office, or relaxation zone. Rich hardwood and designer tile flooring add warmth and style, while the quartz gourmet kitchen features stainless steel appliances including a brand new dishwasher. Additional conveniences include AC,  in-unit laundry, a modern tankless water heater, and a large hallway storage closet. The spacious bedroom offers excellent storage with double closets. Enjoy Promenade facing views from your private balcony, where you can start your morning with sunshine and unwind in the evening as city lights shimmer. Two gated underground parking spaces plus a significant deeded storage cage provide convenience rarely found in urban living. Located in the exclusive beautifully maintained building, the amenities include guest parking, EV charging, a bike room, a stylish club lounge with a kitchen, television, pool table and shuffleboard, a gym with a yoga studio, and an outdoor courtyard with lounge seating and a cozy firepit. High speed internet, water, trash, and sewage are included in the HOA, providing comfort and ease for homeowners. The location is unbeatable, with the beach, boardwalk, marina, Pike Outlets, Shoreline Village, restaurants, cafes, shopping, nightlife, parks, entertainment, and the Metro line all just moments from your front door. Annual Grand Prix excitement and ongoing waterfront development keep this community vibrant and energetic. Looking toward the future, the 2028 Olympics will bring global attention and major international events to Long Beach including beach volleyball, coastal rowing, sailing, target shooting, sport climbing, handball, canoe sprint, and rowing. Live at the center of world class culture, sports, and coastal excitement. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together where the ocean meets the city and your future feels inspired.

results.remarks:
Welcome to Unit 201 at Pars Plaza, a spacious and beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium located in the heart of Downtown Long Beach. This inviting residence offers a bright, open-concept floor plan with abundant natural light, laminate-style flooring, plantation shutters, and a seamless connection between the living and dining areas. The living room is highlighted by a charming marble-accented fireplace and opens to a private balcony surrounded by mature trees—an ideal setting for enjoying fresh air, relaxing, or entertaining.

The dining area features an attractive tray ceiling and flows conveniently into the kitchen, which includes generous cabinetry, tile countertops, a breakfast counter, and major appliances including a refrigerator, gas range, microwave, and dishwasher. A distinctive circular window adds architectural character and additional natural light. The unit also includes an enclosed in-unit washer and dryer with nearby storage, making everyday living more convenient. Both bedrooms offer comfortable proportions, ample closet space, plantation shutters, and flexibility for use as sleeping quarters, a home office, or guest accommodations. Two full bathrooms complete the practical and comfortable interior layout.

Built in 1990, Pars Plaza offers secured entry, an intercom system, elevators, trash chutes, a central courtyard and patio area, and a gated subterranean parking garage. Unit 201 includes two assigned parking spaces—an especially valuable convenience in Downtown Long Beach—along with access to limited guest parking. The building is situated on a tree-lined residential street near Pine Avenue, The Promenade, Shoreline Village, the Aquarium of the Pacific, shopping, dining, entertainment, public transportation, and convenient access to the 710 Freeway. Offering comfort, security, parking, and a highly walkable downtown location, Unit 201 presents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors seeking a low-maintenance home near everything Long Beach has to offer.

This bright and inviting 2 bedroom/ 1.25 bath corner unit offers about 876 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with the added benefit of no one living above you.
The updated galley kitchen offers generous counter space, wood cabinetry, and a functional layout perfect for everyday living. A convenient 1/4 bath completes the main level.
Upstairs, you’ll find two spacious bedrooms with excellent closet space and a full bathroom featuring a tub. One bedroom opens directly to a private upper-level balcony overlooking the courtyard. The perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day.

Located in the heart of Long Beach, just minutes from 4th Street Retro Row, the beach, Downtown Long Beach, Recreation Park, shopping, dining, and convenient freeway access. With its unique two-story floor plan, corner-unit location, private garage, and central Long Beach setting, 725 Coronado #206 is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy everything this vibrant neighborhood has to offer.

results.remarks: ***Private, move-in ready unit in the gated, highly coveted Bridgeport Condominium Complex*** This home offers a rare combination of privacy, greenbelt views, and everyday convenience in the highly desirable neighborhood of Belmont Heights! Once inside, you’ll appreciate the thoughtful layout featuring an expanded, eat-in kitchen that flows into a separate dining room serving as extra space to lounge and socialize, living room with gas & wood burning fireplace, master bedroom with en suite bathroom, and in-unit laundry. Two private outdoor spaces set this home further apart: a covered balcony off the dining area with views of the Red Car Greenbelt that is perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding, while a patio off the master bedroom extends your living space and offers a peaceful retreat just steps from where you sleep. The Bridgeport community delivers resort-style amenities including a sparkling pool, relaxing spa, secure subterranean parking with two side by side spaces, a private storage unit, and bike storage room — ideal for the active Southern California lifestyle. You are surrounded by shops, restaurants, and recreation areas that put everything you need within reach. Do not miss out on this amazing opportunity!!

Ideally situated in one of Long Beach's most dynamic and walkable neighborhoods, this move-in ready 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home is attractively priced for its generous size and sought-after location, offering an exceptional opportunity to enjoy today while adding your own style and design touches over time.

The open-concept kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite features double-door entry, a walk-in closet with custom organizers, an additional mirrored wardrobe closet, and a private en-suite bathroom. The well-sized secondary bedroom offers generous mirrored closet space and is conveniently located adjacent to a full bathroom with a linen closet.

Additional conveniences include inside laundry, two assigned gated parking spaces, a newer HVAC system, and a private balcony for relaxing outdoors.

Experience the best of coastal city living just moments from Downtown Long Beach, Shoreline Village, the waterfront, local cafés, acclaimed restaurants, art galleries, boutique shops, and year-round entertainment. results.remarks:
Your view, your balcony, your walk to everything. This third-floor corner condo at The Tiffany delivers privacy, a peek-a-boo city view, and a location that puts Downtown Long Beach's best right outside your door, all behind the security of a gated community.

Step outside and Shoreline Drive, The Pike Outlets, the Aquarium of the Pacific, and Shoreline Aquatic Park are all within easy walking distance, along with the restaurants and nightlife that make this neighborhood one of the city's most sought-after. Morning coffee by the water, dinner two blocks from home; this is the lifestyle.

Inside, sunlight and coastal breeze move freely through an open layout that leads out to a private balcony, your own spot to unwind, do a little yoga, or sip on your coffee. The kitchen pairs quartz countertops with a smart, functional layout built for both quick meals and entertaining.

The primary suite offers a private ensuite bath, while a beautifully updated guest bathroom serves the rest of the home. Thoughtful upgrades such as new closet doors throughout and ceiling fans in every bedroom add comfort and polish. An in-unit stackable washer and dryer means laundry day never leaves home.

The building itself delivers everyday ease with an elevator and a quiet courtyard retreat.

This is low-maintenance coastal living at its most convenient. Schedule your showing and then pack your bags for your new Long Beach home!

results.remarks:
Perched on the top floor as a coveted corner residence, 1509 Stanley Ave, Unit 304 offers the perfect blend of modern living, panoramic city views, and an unbeatable Long Beach lifestyle. Beautifully renovated and move-in ready, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath home is filled with natural light and showcases sweeping views of the Long Beach skyline. From your private balcony, enjoy morning coffee with the sunrise or unwind in the evening while taking in the city's sparkling lights—and even watch seasonal fireworks displays from the comfort of home.
Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully redesigned interior featuring a remodeled kitchen, beautifully renovated bathrooms, fresh interior paint, and an open-concept layout that's ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite provides a peaceful retreat, while the in-unit washer and dryer add the convenience today's buyers are looking for.
Location is where this home truly shines. Just minutes from Long Beach's beautiful coastline, you're approximately five minutes from the beach, waterfront bike paths, Bluff Park, and Junipero Beach, making it easy to embrace Southern California's outdoor lifestyle. Enjoy weekends exploring Belmont Shore's vibrant Second Street with its boutiques, cafés, restaurants, and nightlife, or spend the day paddleboarding, biking, or strolling through the picturesque Naples canals. Downtown Long Beach, Shoreline Village, and The Pike are also just a short drive away, offering shopping, entertainment, dining, and waterfront attractions.

Whether you're purchasing your first home, downsizing without compromise, or adding a quality investment to your portfolio, this rare top-floor corner condo delivers the space, style, views, and location that are increasingly difficult to find at this price point. This is more than a home—it's an opportunity to enjoy the very best of Long Beach living.

This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence combines modern upgrades with exceptional functionality in an ideal coastal location.
The remodeled kitchen features updated cabinetry, newer appliances, lots of counter space, quality finishes, and an inviting breakfast nook with added buffet cabinet and wet bar that opens directly to a private patio—perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or entertaining. The spacious living and dining areas flow effortlessly, creating a bright and comfortable space to relax or host guests.

This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of Long Beach's most sought-after neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Move-in ready and beautifully appointed! This inviting single-level, two-bedroom, two-bath condominium offers comfortable, easy living in the desirable gated, resort-style community of Stoneybrook Villas. Southwest-facing and filled with natural light, the residence features a spacious private balcony with dual-pane sliding glass doors that open to peaceful treetop views and some sparkling city lights, an ideal setting for morning coffee, relaxing evenings, or casual entertaining. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers an easy flow between the living, dining, and outdoor spaces, while both bedrooms enjoy the comfort and convenience of single-level living. The residence features fresh interior paint, newer carpet in the living areas, tile kitchen and bathroom flooring, newer kitchen appliances, updated lighting and hardware, smooth ceilings, and dual-pane sliders. Both baths have been tastefully updated, with one offering a convenient, beautiful step-in shower and the other featuring a relaxing soaking tub, both with a touch of European flair. Additional highlights include central air conditioning and heat, abundant storage, two generous walk-in wardrobe closets, and large hallway linen and storage closets. Two deeded covered subterranean parking spaces with an additional storage locker.  Convenient in-building community laundry facilities complete the package. Stoneybrook Villas is one of Long Beach's premier gated communities, featuring beautifully landscaped grounds with mature trees, meandering streams, expansive greenbelts, and an impressive array of resort-style amenities. Residents enjoy multiple swimming pools and spas, saunas, tennis courts, a fitness center, a clubhouse, a basketball court, and numerous inviting outdoor spaces. Ideally located with convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County, the community is just minutes from CSULB, Belmont Shore, the beach, 2nd & PCH, Marine Stadium, and Marina Vista Park. Enjoy nearby biking and walking trails, kayaking, paddleboarding, the weekly farmers' market, summer concerts in the park, and an abundance of shopping, dining, and entertainment. Whether you're seeking a full-time residence, weekend retreat, or investment opportunity, this beautifully updated condominium offers an appealing blend of comfort, convenience, and the distinctive Stoneybrook Villas lifestyle.

results.remarks:
Leave the car parked and experience one of Long Beach’s most walkable neighborhoods from this beautifully updated one bedroom condo in the heart of Bluff Park. Just two blocks from the coast and one block from the shops, restaurants and coffee spots along Broadway, this is a location that makes everyday life feel a little more like a vacation. Start the morning with a walk along the bluff, catch a sunset over the ocean, visit the weekly farmers market or head to Belmont Shore and 2nd Street just minutes away. With a 90 Walk Score, some of the best of Long Beach is right outside your front door.
Located inside the Carlton Imperial, a Mid Century building designed by renowned local architect and builder Paul McKenzie, this 753 square foot home offers the spacious layout and abundant natural light his buildings are known for. Inside, the living and dining areas overlook the landscaped courtyard and feature vinyl plank flooring, crown molding, plantation shutters and numerous windows.
The updated kitchen features granite countertops, green glass tile backsplash, white cabinetry, tile flooring, all electric appliances and a new dishwasher. The full bathroom has also been updated with a porcelain vessel sink, granite counter and tile flooring.
The generously sized bedroom offers two separate closet spaces, including a wall length closet with two entrances and an additional space perfect as an office nook, creating an ideal work from home setup or additional storage. Built in hallway cabinetry provides even more room to keep everything organized.
The secure building offers controlled entry, subterranean parking, elevator access and a well maintained interior courtyard. The unit includes one assigned parking space along with additional storage and the building is pet friendly.
Whether you’re looking for your first home, a Long Beach pied à terre or simply a lifestyle where the beach, coffee, dinner and everyday essentials are all within walking distance, 2772 E 2nd St #E2 puts you in the middle of what makes Bluff Park such a special place to live.

The second bedroom is also spacious and includes a HUGE walk-in closet, while the guest bathroom is upgraded and move-in ready with a tub/shower combination, vanity, and updated lighting.

results.remarks: A premier opportunity in the gated Stoneybrook Villas Resort community! This beautifully situated two-bedroom, two-bath end unit overlooks lush landscaping and tranquil brooks, offering a peaceful and private setting. Designed with excellent spatial flow for comfortable living, the home features an extended private patio accessible from the living room and both bedrooms—perfect for seamless indoor/outdoor enjoyment. The residence has been freshly painted and updated with new lighting fixtures and hardware. The kitchen and both baths offer hard-surface flooring (only first-floor units at Stoneybrook are permitted by the HOA to install hard-surface flooring throughout. Additional highlights include central air conditioning and heat, abundant storage with two oversized walk-in wardrobe closets and a spacious hallway linen/storage closet, an open-concept layout, in-building laundry, and two subterranean side-by-side parking spaces (very rare, most double-parking spaces are tandem). The quiet, gated HOA community offers resort-style amenities amid verdant greenbelts, including two swimming pools, three spas, two saunas, two tennis courts, a clubhouse, fitness center, bike storage rooms, multiple BBQ areas, and convenient building laundry facilities. Ideally located for commuters traveling to Orange County or Los Angeles, and just a five-minute bike ride to the beach, Belmont Shore, 2nd & PCH, and The Marketplace. Enjoy easy access to Marine Stadium, the Marina Vista Park Farmers’ Market, and summer Concerts in the Park. With an excellent walkability score and an unbeatable lifestyle location, this one is truly a winner!

Upon entry, you're welcomed by warm laminate flooring that flows seamlessly throughout the home and a stunning remodeled kitchen featuring quartz countertops, Shaker-style cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and an elegant decorative accent wall.

Step outside to your private patio retreat, where the gentle sounds of a nearby stream and lush greenery create a tranquil setting for morning coffee or evening relaxation. results.remarks: SCORE!  I doubt location gets better than this!  Welcome to The Lakes.  A fun, lush gated community located in East Long Beach-near the border of Los Alamitos.  This spacious one bedroom END UNIT loft has it all!  And guess what, there's NO ONE above or below you!  Just steps from your assigned covered carport, and even closer to your newly redone laundry room, convenience is the name of the game!  But wait until you see the view!  If you're a nature nut, this place is a slice of heaven.  The Lakes boasts of being a wildlife habitat with: geese, ducks, koi fish, turtles, frogs, lizards, exotic birds, and squirrels...you won't feel lonely here!  And how about entertainment and amenities?  Come enjoy two tennis courts, two swimming pools, and spas, and a fitness room.  Or how about the clubhouse for pool, ping pong, or a book from the book room.  Your guests will love hanging out for the day! The property offers plenty of guest parking spaces, not far from your unit.  The unit has beautiful high vaulted ceilings, and plenty of storage between the carport, and closet off the covered patio.  This streamline design integrates function and a cool vibe.  Enjoy the art deco FIREPLACE overlooking a large, beautiful pond, instead of butting up to a neighbor's window.  If you should feel like escaping paradise, it's just a short walk to El Dorado park.  An amazing expansive recreation ground with its own nature center.  Come take a look, you'll love what you see!  (HOA covers: water, and trash!) Unit is just off the West end/corner of the tennis courts.

Easy access to both Orange County and Los Angeles makes this an especially attractive location for commuters.

results.remarks:
Welcome to coastal city living at Ocean Gate in vibrant Downtown Long Beach! This inviting residence features a bright, open-concept floor plan accented by upgraded flooring throughout, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and hosting guests. Step outside to relax on your spacious 3rd-floor private balcony, which offers tranquil views of the surrounding treetops. Thoughtfully designed for maximum privacy and convenience, the home boasts two spacious bedroom suites—each complete with its own private ensuite bathroom—as well as an in-unit washer and dryer.

Living here places you right at the intersection of urban energy and outdoor recreation. Enjoy green space directly across the street at César E. Chávez Park and the Jenny Oropeza Community Center, or take advantage of being just steps from the modern Long Beach Civic Center plaza, the Billie Jean King Main Library, and the George Deukmejian Courthouse. Hop onto the neighboring LA River Bike Path for a quick ride to the shoreline or DTLA, and explore the endless dining, shopping, and entertainment options that Downtown Long Beach and iconic Ocean Boulevard have to offer. Commuters will appreciate the effortless access to the 710 freeway, while weekend adventurers are just minutes from the Catalina Express terminal for easy island getaways.

The well-maintained Ocean Gate community offers controlled smart access, a fully equipped fitness center, and a versatile recreation room—all paired with exceptionally low HOA dues. Rounding out this complete package are two assigned parking spaces (#16 & 19) along with additional private storage.
